title: Only 3 Interstellar Visitors Have Ever Reached Us
hook: Only 3 interstellar visitors have ever crossed our solar system.
closing: Each rare visitor gives us a physical sample of another star system.
question: Will we ever catch one?

segments.say: Only 3 interstellar visitors have been confirmed, making every arrival a rare scientific opportunity.
The newest visitor reached 246,000 kilometers per hour, faster than either object before it.
Its nucleus measures 5.6 kilometers, giving scientists more material to study than the previous visitor.
